title: Senior Manager MES / Manufacturing Transformation | m/w/d
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Msg Industry Advisors Ag
description_html:
Your mission

You’re a team player, authentic, open, and face challenges with a positive mindset? Then you’re a perfect fit for us! 

  • Take end-to-end ownership of international MES and Manufacturing Transformation programs – from program setup, governance, solution design, and implementation through to rollout, go-live, and stabilization – while keeping scope, roadmap, budget, resources, risks, and dependencies firmly under control.
  • Across complex multi-site programs, you bring together business functions, IT, Quality, sites, vendors, and system integrators, providing clear direction to project teams throughout demanding and critical phases.
  • Functional projects and workstreams covering process optimization and harmonization, solution design, system integration, data flows, and data migration are managed with confidence, while validation activities can also be supported conceptually at both program and project level.
  • With a comprehensive understanding of the relevant functional and technical concepts, you identify dependencies early and work closely with experts to develop and evaluate robust solutions.
  • Particularly during rollout, readiness, and go-live phases, you drive decisions and follow them through, ensure successful delivery, manage escalations, and represent the program confidently towards management, steering committees, and other relevant stakeholders.


Your profile

  • Consulting experience in leading complex international programs and projects within the life sciences or pharmaceutical industry forms the foundation of your expertise.
  • Strong knowledge of MES and Manufacturing IT is complemented by hands-on experience in the implementation, integration, and multi-site rollout of corresponding solutions.
  • Pharmaceutical manufacturing processes and their interfaces with Quality, Automation/OT, ERP/SAP, and other relevant systems are areas in which you are highly confident.
  • A solid understanding of GxP, Computerized Systems Validation, and pharmaceutical Quality processes enables you to translate regulatory requirements effectively into program planning, governance, and delivery.
  • Excellent German and English skills, combined with a willingness to travel internationally, enable you to operate confidently across complex global program environments.


Your start with us

At our company, you’ll find a work environment where initiative, collaboration, and mutual support are truly valued. You can expect exciting projects, a fair salary, plenty of development opportunities, and a flexible working model tailored to your needs.
 
Your journey with us starts with a well-structured onboarding, including two welcome days at our Frankfurt office, a buddy program, and access to internal networks to help you feel at home from day one. We offer full flexibility with flexible working hours, remote work options, and even the chance to work temporarily from abroad.
 
With 30 vacation days plus additional paid leave for special occasions, as well as a time value account for extended breaks like sabbaticals, we ensure you have the space to recharge and balance life and work.
 
Our internal training curriculum, additional learning formats, and tailored development paths support your individual career goals. Regular events, cross-location networks, and our feedback platform miaX create space for exchange, ideas, and collaboration.
 
We support your well-being with a subsidized Urban Sports Club membership and exclusive perks through our Corporate Benefits platform. You can also privately use your company IT equipment, and stay mobile with flexible options like JobRad, a company car, or a BahnCard. And because we value your network, we reward successful referrals with an attractive bonus.
 
We work in a hybrid model: depending on the project requirements, you will work remotely, in one of our offices or directly at the customer's premises.


How to contact us

Apply directly or send us your application documents (CV, certificates, desired salary and possible start date) by e-mail to: https://linktr.ee/msgindustryadvisors
Do you have questions or need more information about the position or career opportunities at msg industry advisors?

salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at BRÜGGEN ENGINEERING GmbH
description_html:
Ihre Karriere in der Automatisierungstechnik industrieller Prozessanlagen.

Mit BRÜGGEN ENGINEERING planen und realisieren Sie anspruchsvolle Automatisierungsprojekte für verfahrenstechnische Produktionsanlagen. Sie begleiten Projekte vom Basic- und Detailengineering über die technische Auslegung und Projektsteuerung bis zur Inbetriebnahme und sorgen für eine zuverlässige Automatisierung, Mess- und Regelungstechnik sowie sichere OT-Infrastrukturen.

Aufgaben

  • Projektierung: Sie bearbeiten und leiten Projekte mit Schwerpunkt Automatisierungstechnik sowie Mess-, Regelungs- und Steuerungstechnik im Bereich verfahrenstechnischer Produktionsanlagen
  • Projektsteuerung: Sie planen Ressourcen, Kosten und Termine und dokumentieren den Projektfortschritt im Projektmanagementsystem
  • Engineering: Sie führen Machbarkeitsstudien sowie Basic- und Detailengineering durch, erstellen technische Ausschreibungsunterlagen und bewerten Angebote zu Investitionsentscheidungen
  • Systemauslegung: Sie konzipieren Automatisierungs- und OT-Netzwerksysteme sowie Mess-, Regelungs- und Maschinensicherheitseinrichtungen
  • Monitoring: Sie koordinieren die Ausführung vor Ort und begleiten Montage, Bauleitung und Inbetriebnahme der technischen Systeme
  • Konformität: Sie berücksichtigen geltende Vorschriften und technische Standards und wirken bei der Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung interner Vorgaben mit

Qualifikation

  • Qualifikation: Abgeschlossene elektrotechnische Berufsausbildung sowie Studium oder Weiterbildung als staatlich geprüfte:r Techniker:in in Automatisierungstechnik, Elektrotechnik, Mechatronik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung und erfüllen die Voraussetzungen zur Ernennung zur Elektrofachkraft gemäß DIN VDE 1000-10
  • Projekterfahrung: Erfahrung in der Planung und Koordination elektrotechnischer Projekte an industriellen Produktionsanlagen
  • Automatisierung: Kenntnisse in Automatisierungssystemen wie Siemens SIMATIC S7, PCS 7 oder Valmet DNA
  • Programmierung: Erfahrung in Programmierung und Diagnose von Prozessleitsystemen, beispielsweise mit TIA Portal oder Valmet DNA Explorer
  • Elektroplanung: Grundkenntnisse in der Erstellung elektrotechnischer Planungsunterlagen mit eCAD-Systemen wie COMOS oder EPLAN
  • Arbeitsweise: Technisches Verständnis sowie eine strukturierte, eigenständige und lösungsorientierte Vorgehensweise

Benefits

  • Attraktive Konditionen: Freuen Sie sich auf eine unbefristete Vollzeitstelle bei BRÜGGEN ENGINEERING mit einer Vergütung, die Ihrer Qualifikation und Erfahrung entspricht
  • Zukunftssichere Projekte: Arbeiten Sie an anspruchsvollen Automatisierungsprojekten für moderne verfahrenstechnische Produktionsanlagen und begleiten Sie diese vom Engineering bis zur Inbetriebnahme
  • Dynamisches Team: Werden Sie Teil eines Teams, das Wert auf fachlichen Austausch, persönliche Weiterentwicklung und gegenseitige Unterstützung legt

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen mit
Angabe Ihres frühesten Starttermins und Ihrer Gehaltsvorstellung.

Ihr Ansprechpartner für Ihre Bewerbung ist:
Dipl.-Wirt.-Ing. Thorsten Schermann

title: Senior Product Designer - Sell Online
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at SumUp
description_html:
Senior Product Designer – Sell Online

About the team

The Sell Online team builds the products that help small business owners run and grow their businesses online — from appointment bookings and online stores to customer management. We're a cross-functional design team embedded across multiple product squads, working closely with product managers and engineers to shape experiences used by millions of merchants worldwide. As we expand our portfolio and grow our engineering capacity, we're looking for a Senior Product Designer who can bring strong visual craft, product thinking, and the confidence to own complex design challenges across several product areas simultaneously.

🎥 Get a feel for our Berlin office: Take a look

What you'll do

  • Own end-to-end design across our Bookings and Online Store products — from early-stage concepts and user flows through to polished, high-fidelity UI ready for development
  • Craft visually compelling interfaces, including iconography and illustrations, that raise the bar for quality and consistency across the portfolio
  • Work across multiple squads simultaneously, collaborating closely with product managers, engineers and other designers to keep design and delivery in sync
  • Contribute to and evolve our design system, ensuring consistency and scalability as the product portfolio grows
  • Use qualitative research and user data to inform design decisions and validate solutions — bringing a user-centred lens to everything you ship

You'll be great for this role if…

  • You have a strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product design — from wireframes and user flows to high-fidelity UI — with a clear emphasis on visual craft, typography, and layout
  • You have experience designing for customer-facing products on both web and mobile, ideally in e-commerce, bookings, or similar consumer contexts
  • You have proven ability to work with and contribute to design systems at scale
  • You are comfortable with managing multiple workstreams and stakeholders across different product areas at the same time
  • You have a collaborative, curious mindset — someone who listens well, adapts quickly, and can navigate ambiguity without losing momentum

Why you should join SumUp

🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup
🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced
🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success
📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education
💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions
🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave plus public holidays and special leave days
🏋️ Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, subsidised office lunches
🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service
🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

About SumUp

Be empowered to do more that matters.

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 37 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify.

SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited.

Discover more about our culture and opportunities on our careers website, and follow our journey on LinkedIn, Instagram, and

Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

title: (Senior) QA Engineer - AI-Driven Testing (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at 1KOMMA5˚
description_html:
1KOMMA5°

At 1KOMMA5°, we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?

We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.

Learn about our Product & Tech team!

Deine Position

As part of our Mobile App Platform team, you will own the quality strategy of our Flutter apps, and change how we approach testing.

AI-driven QA is the differentiator in this role. Our QA team already uses AI for test generation, but we want to go much further. You will help reinvent it: autonomous exploration, smarter test orchestration, self-directed QA workflows, and QA systems that detect product risks before they reach users.

This is not a "write test cases and file tickets" role. You co-create systems and practices that enable our product teams to own product quality end-to-end and work with them to close the gaps so we can ship with confidence. Speed boost instead of speed bump.
You think about quality as something you design into the product and process, not a checklist you run before release, effectively shifting quality assurance left.

Our Stack

  • Flutter & Dart
  • Appium, BrowserStack
  • Testmo for test case management
  • GCP, GitHub Actions, Datadog, LaunchDarkly
  • AI-assisted development with Cursor and agentic coding workflows
  • Linear, Notion, Figma, Miro Key Responsibilities
  • App Platform Quality Ownership: Own the quality strategy of our Flutter apps and testing architecture across our mobile product teams from a platform standpoint, including test strategy, execution, and production monitoring
  • Platform Collaboration & Support: Partner closely with cross-functional mobile product teams to shape quality practices, close testing gaps, and enable teams to ship with confidence
  • Automated Test Suite Management: Grow and maintain our automated test suite (Appium / BrowserStack), keeping it fast, stable, trusted, and focused on critical user journeys
  • Test Infrastructure Health: Keep test infrastructure healthy with minimized flakiness, faster runs, and actionable results for the entire engineering organization
  • Autonomous & AI-Driven Exploration: Create and scale autonomous exploration, intelligent test orchestration, and self-directed testing workflows from scratch to detect product risks before they reach users

Dein Profil

  • User-Centric Quality Focus: Strong focus on real-world user journeys, edge cases, and product risk rather than relying solely on code coverage metrics
  • Comfortable with Ambiguity: High initiative and problem-solving drive to invent solutions from scratch when no standard playbook exists
  • QA Architecture & Mobile Automation: Extensive experience designing scalable testing strategies and hands-on expertise with mobile automation frameworks (Appium, Flutter integration testing) and cloud device farms (BrowserStack)
  • Practical AI & Agentic Workflows: Active experience leveraging AI tools, LLM workflows, and testing agents for autonomous exploration, automated test generation, and defect analysis
  • CI/CD & Platform Enablement: Proven track record of integrating test suites into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) to deliver fast quality signals and co-creating practices that enable product teams to own quality without sacrificing velocity
  • User-Centric Quality & Communication: Focus on real-world user journeys and risk mitigation over simple coverage metrics, backed by strong English communication skills to guide engineering practices Bonus points for:
  • German language skills
  • Experience with energy systems, IoT, or climate tech
  • Native iOS/Android or deep Flutter/Dart architecture knowledge
  • Track record of navigating ambiguity
  • Experience in building testing tools from scratch

Benefits

  • You are part of an international, dynamic, and highly motivated team of people who have proven to make things happen
  • With your work, you accelerate the "energy transition" and hence have a direct impact on our climate
  • Work with and learn from other super-smart colleagues
  • You will enjoy direct contact with core decision-makers
  • You will enjoy the best chances of entering full-time in one of Europe’s most thriving scaleups
  • You work remotely (Germany-wide), with offices in Hamburg, Berlin or Munich
  • Create a healthy balance alongside your work and enjoy all the benefits of the EGYM Wellpass
  • Benefits and discounts are yours with Futurebens
  • Whether city bike or e-bike - be flexible with our job bike leasing and do something good for the environment at the same time

title: CRM / Customer Relationship Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Neotaste
description_html:
Let us give you a taste

Werde Teil unserer Mission, die Food-Tech-Branche zu revolutionieren, und schließ' dich einer der am schnellsten wachsenden Restaurant-Discovery-Apps an!

Deine Mission:

  • Ad-hoc-Engagement-Kampagnen: Du planst, verfasst und setzt Newsletter-Initiativen um, die gezielt die Nutzerinteraktion in unserer B2C-App-Community in Deutschland, Österreich, den Niederlanden und Großbritannien steigern.

  • Kreatives Copywriting: Du erstellst mitreißende und conversionstarke CRM-Texte, die unsere food-begeisterte Zielgruppe direkt ansprechen und perfekt zur Brand von NeoTaste passen.

  • CRM-Tool-Operations: Du erstellst und versendest Kampagnennachrichten über moderne CRM-Plattformen - Bei NeoTaste nutzen wir Braze.

  • Testing & Analyse: Du testest laufend neue Content- und Kampagnen-Ideen und analysierst die relevanten CRM-KPIs über den gesamten Lifecycle hinweg, von Open & Click Rates über Conversion bis zu Retention und Reaktivierung. Daraus leitest du konkrete Maßnahmen ab, um Engagement und User Retention nachhaltig zu steigern.

  • Team-Unterstützung: Du unterstützt das gesamte CRM-Team im Tagesgeschäft, hilfst beim Aufbau automatisierter Workflows und schaffst so Möglichkeiten für Strategie und Prozessoptimierung.

Dein Profil:

  • Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau: Hervorragende schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten auf Deutsch sind zwingend erforderlich, um ansprechende CRM-Messages zu verfassen. Verhandlungssicheres Englisch wird für die Zusammenarbeit im Team vorausgesetzt.

  • 1–3 Jahre Berufserfahrung: Hintergrund im Bereich CRM oder digitales Kampagnenmanagement inklusive nachweisbarer Erfahrung im Copywriting für E-Mail- und Push-Nachrichten.

  • Erfahrung mit CRM-Plattformen: Praktische Erfahrung mit CRM-Tools (Braze, MoEngage, Klaviyo etc.). Hands-on-Erfahrung mit Braze ist ein großer Pluspunkt.

  • Kreativ & detailorientiert: Ein Blick für ansprechende Inhalte gepaart mit hoher Sorgfalt bei Formatierung, Tonalität und Korrekturlesen. Praktische Erfahrung mit Figma ist ein großer Pluspunkt.

  • Analytisches Denkvermögen: Es fällt dir leicht, Engagement-Daten zu lesen, Trends zu erkennen und Erkenntnisse zur Optimierung zukünftiger Kampagnen zu nutzen.

  • Hands-on-Mentalität: Strukturierte & proaktive Arbeitsweise sowie die Bereitschaft Ad-hoc-Anfragen eigenverantwortlich umzusetzen.

Warum wir?

  • Großer Impact - Jede:r Mitarbeiter:in hat bei uns eine Stimme, die gehört wird und die Möglichkeit, Großes zu Leisten und persönlich zu wachsen.

  • Remote Work & flexible Arbeitszeiten - Arbeite von dem Ort aus, an dem du am produktivsten bist, und gestalte deinen Arbeitstag flexibel nach deinen Bedürfnissen. Wir schätzen aber auch die Zusammenarbeit vor Ort, daher freuen wir uns, dich für ein paar Tage die Woche bei uns im Berliner Office zu sehen!

  • Sport- & Wellness-Vorteile - Nutze Urban Sports, Hansefit oder Hussle, um aktiv zu bleiben und neue Energie zu tanken.

  • Budget für Weiterbildung und Entwicklung - Übernimm Verantwortung für deine individuellen Lernziele und deinen Entwicklung.

  • NeoTaste Abo für dich und eine:n Freund:in - Komm selbst in den Genuss von NeoTaste und teile deine Leidenschaft für gutes Essen.

  • Hochwertige Arbeitsausstattung - Du erhältst erstklassige technische Ausstattung von Apple.

  • Zusätzliche Urlaubstage - Am 24. und 31. Dezember hast du frei, egal in welchem Land du dich befindest.

  • Company Offsites & regelmäßige Teamevents - Nimm an virtuellen und persönlichen Events teil und vernetze dich mit deinem Team.

 

Klingt gut?

Die Beschreibung passt zu Dir? Schick uns eine kurze Nachricht und sag uns warum Du der/die Richtige für den Job bist! Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung.

Hinweis zum Gehalt gemäß Entgelttransparenzgesetz: Unsere Gehaltsspanne für diese Position liegt zwischen 42.000,00 € und 50.000,00 € pro Jahr, abhängig von deinen individuellen Fähigkeiten, deiner Berufserfahrung und der Einordnung in unser internes Job Leveling Framework.

About us

At NeoTaste we develop the platform for you to discover new restaurants in your city. As a user, you can enjoy special deals that are exclusive to us and allow you to discover the culinary diversity of the city. 

On the other hand, we are also the partner for restaurants to win new customers who do not yet know their go-to food place. The restaurants can adjust their special deals individually to their capacity, which helps them increase their occupancy and thus their revenue. 
We are looking for enthusiastic and motivated team players who are eager to build something great with us.

  • We're present in over 50 cities in the DACH region, the Netherlands & the UK and are expanding into Europe

  • More than 2,5 million users love our app

  • We're a team of more than 60 employees

  • We have raised €21Million in the last two years

title: Group Design Platform Software & AI Architect (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at SGB-SMIT Group
description_html:
Transform with us the future of energy ⚡

The SGB‑SMIT Group is an international transformer manufacturer with locations in Europe, Asia and America. With reliable transformer technology, the company actively supports the global energy transition in areas such as renewable energy, industry and urban energy infrastructure.

As a key link between power generation, transmission and distribution, SGB‑SMIT Group develops and manufactures power transformers, distribution transformers, cast‑resin transformers and custom solutions for data centers, industrial applications and e‑mobility. These products ensure efficient, stable and secure energy flows worldwide.

With more than 3,800 employees worldwide, the SGB‑SMIT Group stands for quality, innovation and sustainability and offers a stable environment to work on technologies that shape the energy systems of the future.

What sets the SGB-SMIT Group apart: 🌍

We combine the strength of an international technology company with an employee-oriented corporate culture:

  • Meaningful work at the heart of the energy transition

  • Short decision-making processes and direct cooperation

  • Stable, growing company with long-term prospects

Your contribution counts – both professionally and personally.

Your benefits at SGB-SMIT Group: 🚀

  • Stable, growing company with long-term prospects

  • Attractive salary and social benefits

  • Flexible working hours and hybrid working models

  • 30+1 vacation days plus special leave

  • Training and development opportunities

  • Company pension plan and employee insurance

  • Health and fitness offers (HanseFit)

  • Company restaurant, free drinks, and e-charging parking spaces

  • Bicycle and IT leasing

  • Subsidy for Germany/RVV ticket

  • Employee discounts via Benify

Your tasks: 📌

  • Define and continuously develop the software and implementation architecture of our Group Design Platform, including modules, interfaces, data ownership and technical roadmaps.

  • Provide technical leadership for the existing C#/.NET environment and guide its development toward scalable, maintainable and testable solutions.

  • Evaluate technical alternatives, dependencies and risks, and document architecture decisions and recommendations transparently.

  • Establish software development standards for coding, APIs, data models, automated testing, versioning, documentation and code reviews.

  • Identify and assess AI use cases, technologies and models, and guide the implementation of selected AI-enabled platform capabilities.

  • Collaborate with Product Owners, project managers, engineering experts, users and development teams to deliver appropriate technical solutions.

  • Review software designs, critical code, integration concepts and supplier proposals to ensure compliance with the platform architecture.

  • Drive modernization, refactoring, performance improvement, cybersecurity and technical-debt reduction while supporting Agile/Scrum and stage-gate processes

Your profile: 🔎

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a comparable technical discipline.

  • At least eight years of professional software development experience, including several years in software architecture or technical leadership.

  • Strong hands-on expertise in C# and the .NET ecosystem, ideally gained in complex engineering, desktop, web or service applications.

  • In-depth knowledge of software architecture, domain-driven design, modular architectures, design patterns, APIs, data architecture and system integration.

  • Practical experience with AI-enabled software, model integration, data pipelines, workflow orchestration, evaluation, monitoring and governance.

  • Good knowledge of DevOps, CI/CD, source control, automated testing, release pipelines and secure software development.

  • Strong analytical, communication, mentoring and stakeholder-management skills, combined with the ability to guide distributed and external development teams.

  • English skills at C1 level or equivalent. Knowledge of German and experience with industrial engineering software, PLM, CAD, SAP, databases or cloud architectures are additional advantages.

If you value a dynamic, growing, and intercultural environment and enjoy hands-on work, then become part of the SGB-SMIT Group - transform with us the future of energy. ⚡

We look forward to receiving your application! ⚡

Learn more about the SGB-SMIT Group as an employer, our values, and career opportunities on our careers page:

https://www.sgb-smit.com/career-jobs/sgb-smit-group#/

The terms used in this text refer to all genders in accordance with the General Equal Treatment Act (AGG).


.

title: Senior Data Scientist (m/f/x)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Makersite GmbH
description_html:
Data Scientist (m/f/x) 

Location: EU

(Remote) 

 

Who You’ll Work For: 

 

At Makersite, we're pioneering the future of sustainable product development and digital collaboration. As a leading platform for product lifecycle management (PLM), we empower companies to make smarter, more sustainable decisions across their entire supply chain. Our cutting-edge software enables teams to design, prototype, and manufacture with transparency, efficiency, and responsibility—reducing environmental impact while optimizing performance. 

We're a fast-growing, innovative company that thrives on creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning. If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation. 

 

Who we're looking for: 

 

As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Data Scientists who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. Ifyou're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you! 

This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will receive a permanent employment contract regardless of location.  

 

The role:  

Develop and Deploy Production-Grade AI Systems 

  • Build, deploy, and maintain scalable APIs that serve AI/ML models in production environments 

  • Own end-to-end delivery of AI solutions, from prototyping to fully productionized systems 

Design Advanced AI Architectures 

  • Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems using vector databases 

  • Build and orchestrate AI agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, or similar 

  • Evaluate and select appropriate large language models (LLMs) and foundation models based on specific use cases 

Optimize Performance and Scalability 

  • Continuously optimize model inference for latency, cost efficiency, and throughput at scale 

  • Identify bottlenecks and implement improvements to ensure high-performing systems 

Ensure Reliability and Observability 

  • Implement robust monitoring, logging, and alerting for deployed models and services 

  • Ensure system reliability, uptime, and performance through best practices in production ML systems 

Establish Engineering Best Practices 

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for seamless testing, deployment, and iteration of AI systems 

  • Contribute to evolving engineering standards as the company transitions from rapid experimentation to more structured, scalable operations 

Collaborate Cross-Functionally 

  • Work closely with product and engineering teams to integrate AI capabilities into core products 

  • Translate business problems into technical solutions and clearly communicate trade-offs 

Drive Structure in a Fast-Paced Environment 

  • Help bring stability and structure to AI development processes during a high-growth, scale-up phase 

  • Balance speed of execution with the need for maintainable, well-documented, and scalable systems 

  • Take ownership of ambiguous problems and drive them through to practical, production-ready outcomes 


Core Experience 

  • 5+ years of experience in Python, with ~10 years of overall software engineering or data experience (candidates transitioning from backend engineering are welcome) 

  • Proven experience building and deploying production-grade APIs (preferably with FastAPI; REST/GraphQL experience is a plus) 

  • Hands-on experience working with large language models (LLMs) and LLMOps, including prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation (e.g., GPT, Claude) 

  • Strong experience fine-tuning open-source models (e.g., Hugging Face ecosystem) 

  • Practical experience designing and working with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, pgvector) 

  • Experience building AI agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, or similar 

  • Solid understanding of model deployment and serving (e.g., vLLM, TGI, or managed endpoints) 

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern deployment practices (Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions) 

  • Strong experience working with and processing large-scale text datasets 

Preferred Experience 

  • Experience with MLOps platforms such as MLflow or Weights & Biases 

  • Familiarity with cloud AI ecosystems (e.g., AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex AI, Azure OpenAI) 

  • Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects 

  • Experience in the sustainability or climate/product domain 

  • Background in B2B SaaS environments 

  • Prior experience in a startup or scale-up environment (approximately 100–300 employees) 

  • Residing in and legally permitted to work in the EU. 

Key Attributes 

  • Builder mindset: Comfortable owning systems end-to-end, from experimentation through to production 

  • Bias for action: Operates effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment with shifting priorities 

  • Systems thinker: Designs solutions with scalability, reliability, and maintainability in mind 

  • Pragmatic decision-making: Balances technical excellence with speed and business impact 

  • Ownership & accountability: Takes responsibility for outcomes, not just outputs 

  • Clear communicator: Able to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders 

 

What We Offer: 

 

  • Competitive Salary – We reward your skills and experience with a compensation package that reflects your value. 

  • 30 Days Paid Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance. 

  • Remote-First Flexibility – Work from anywhere in the EU, with the option to collaborate in person at our offices in Stuttgart, Berlin (role dependent). 

  • Generous Learning & Development Budget – We invest in your growth, providing ample resources for personal and professional development. 

  • Choose Your Ideal Work Equipment – Whether you prefer Apple or Microsoft, we’ll equip you with the tools you need to excel. 

 

 

The Experience: 

 

  • Purpose-Driven Work – Build something meaningful. Here, you’re not just creating another app; you’re contributing to a transformative vision that you can be proud of. 

  • Great Colleagues – Join a team that’s open, transparent, and international. We value inclusivity and foster a culture of collaboration and mutual respect. 

  • Work-Life Balance – As a remote-first company, we trust you to do your best work, your way. You have the flexibility to work when it suits you, ensuring a healthy balance between personal and professional life. 

  • Pride in Impact – We're already making a significant difference with global, well-known customers who share our vision. Be part of something that matters. 

  • Stability with Ambition – With realistic growth plans, we’re committed to changing the way things are made—without sacrificing our ambitious goals for innovation and impact. 

If you want to find out more about what it’s like to work at Makersite, check out our Careers Page here 

  

Diversity and Inclusion 

If you have a medical condition or an individual need for an adjustment to our process, and you believe this may affect your ability to be at your best – please let us know so we can talk about how we can best support you and make any adjustments that may be needed.  

 

At Makersite, we are dedicated to fostering an environment that champions diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We believe that diverse teams drive innovation and success, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and will consider all applications regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marital status, pregnancy or maternity, race, nationality, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or any other status protected by applicable law. Rest assured, all applications will be handled with the utmost confidentiality.

title: Founding Engineering Team Lead (HandsOn)

description_html:
Berlin • Cybersecurity & AI Startup • Recently Funded

A newly funded cybersecurity startup in Berlin is looking for a Engineering Team Lead to join as a founding team member and help design the core security, identity, and enforcement foundations of a next-generation AI-powered risk management platform.

We are an early-stage startup founded by experienced cybersecurity leaders with backgrounds in Israeli intelligence units.
We are looking for a hands-on Founding Engineering Team Lead for a hybrid role based in central Berlin. If you are passionate about cybersecurity and AI, thrive in fast-paced startup environments, and enjoy building complex platforms from the ground up, this is an opportunity to make a real impact.

They’re building a next-generation cyber risk platform that helps enterprises understand, measure, and reduce identity risk at scale. Their goal is to turn complex identity and security data into clear, actionable risk insights that CISOs and CTOs can trust. You will work from scratch on core platform components from day one, shaping how modern enterprises manage and reason about risk using cloud-native systems, AI-driven analysis, and automated enforcement through AI agents.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead and grow a small, high-performing engineering team while remaining hands-on

  • Design, build, and review production backend and platform code alongside the team

  • Own delivery of the engineering roadmap, balancing speed, quality, and security

  • Act as a technical leader by setting architecture direction and enforcing engineering standards

  • Contribute directly to critical features, integrations, and platform foundations

  • Establish lightweight engineering processes that enable fast execution without bureaucracy

  • Mentor engineers through code reviews, pairing, and technical guidance

  • Contribute hands-on in design and build architecture, configure systems, code 70% of the time in GoLang.

  • Remove blockers and unblock delivery across backend, frontend, data, and DevOps

  • Collaborate closely with CEO, CPTO, and product leadership on technical and execution decisions

  • Support hiring, onboarding, and technical evaluation of engineers

  • Foster a culture of ownership, pragmatism, and low ego

  • Build whole Security platform setup from scratch

  • Partner closely with backend and AI engineers to design secure service boundaries and deployment models

  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex production incidents across infrastructure, networking, and application layers

  • Build PoCs and validate infrastructure and security design decisions in an early-stage environment

  • Support compliance readiness by enabling controls, logging, and evidence collection for security frameworks

  • Continuously improve platform cost efficiency, reliability, and operational maturity

  • This role reports directly to CEO & CPTO


Must have skills

  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience

  • 3+ years of experience leading engineering teams while remaining hands-on

  • 3+ years of GoLang experience

  • 3+ years experience with AWS in production environments

  • Strong code quality bar and experience with architectural reviews

  • Ability to context-switch between technical topics and people leadership

  • Strong execution mindset and comfort operating under ambiguity

  • Hands-on coding mentality; can build things from scratch including security architecture yourself

title: Senior Data Scientist, Forecasting & Elasticity (m/f/x)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at rebuy
description_html:
Ready to become part of the most important mission on this planet?

We are rebuy, pioneers in the sustainable reuse of electronics and media, and we are looking for you! Our mission: to make circular living accessible to all, one transaction at a time. By giving products a second chance, we reduce resource consumption and avoid unnecessary e-waste.

Our global team of 500 drives things forward collaboratively, takes personal responsibility, values constructive critical thinking, and is dedicated to serving our customers and planet.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our Data Science & Analytics team. You will own the forecasting and price elasticity models at the core of rebuy's pricing engine models that directly shape commercial decisions across the business. We care about outcomes, not just predictions: the work you do ships and moves the numbers that matter. We're scaling our impact significantly and need your expertise to take these models further.

You'll own the full end-to-end lifecycle: from business context and model research to automated pipelines and retraining, working closely with senior leadership to translate model insights into commercial strategy.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the end-to-end forecasting and price-elasticity models at the core of our pricing engine — from feature and model research through evaluation, deployment, and continuous monitoring

  • Scale the forecasting architecture to meet growing demand for granular, product-level forecasts

  • Design and run pricing experiments and A/B tests, and turn the results into clear, strategic recommendations for leadership

  • Generate commercial insights through deep-dive analyses of pricing elasticity, customer behavior, market dynamics, and competitive positioning

  • Partner with senior stakeholders across Commercial, Marketing, Product, and Operations to surface opportunities and solve complex business problems

  • Establish best practices for analytics, experimentation, commercial decision-making, and AI usage — and automate the reporting that keeps models and decisions visible


Requirements:

  • 5+ years in a Data Science role, ideally in e-commerce or marketplace environments, solving a range of real business problems (we care about what you've built, not your exact title or tenure)

  • A quantitative degree in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field

  • Strong foundations in statistics, predictive modeling, and machine learning, with hands-on Python and SQL

  • Hands-on experience with time series forecasting — modeling, feature engineering, and evaluation

  • Experience designing and running A/B tests and experiments with measurable business impact

  • A proactive, self-starting mindset — you own a domain end-to-end and care about pricing, forecasting, and e-commerce dynamics

  • Strong stakeholder management and comfort presenting to and influencing senior leadership

Preferred:

  • You use AI tools daily to work faster and push what's possible

  • Knowledge of causal inference methods and advanced experimental design

  • Familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Power BI)

  • Experience in sustainability-focused or circular economy businesses

Location:

  • Berlin

  • Hybrid model (Must be willing to work from the office at least 2 days a week)


Purpose, a great company culture and incredible benefits - what to expect at rebuy:

  • Work with a friendly team that is passionate about circularity and wants to make the world a little more sustainable, one transaction at a time.

  • Feel comfortable in an environment where independence and new ideas are welcome.

  • Benefit from flat hierarchies and the greatest possible transparency so that things don't take longer than they have to and you always feel well informed.

  • Enjoy our centrally located office in Berlin (Erkelenzdamm 11 - 13, 10999 Berlin).

  • Benefit from our family-friendly, flexible environment and paid child sick leave.

  • Bring your dog to the office: we love animals and want to cuddle yours, too!

  • Use employee discounts on rebuy.de, sustainable products at Futurebens, offers for sustainable micro-mobility and massages directly in our office.

  • Have fun at our legendary team and company events.

  • Use our mental health offers as part of a cooperation with Nilo. 

  • Take care of your work-life balance with 30 vacation days.

  • Stay active with our own gym located directly in the building, making it easy to fit workouts into your daily routine.

  • Benefit from an on-site daycare in the building, supporting a truly family friendly and flexible working environment.

*At rebuy all people are welcome and supported! We would like to talk, regardless of age, disability, national and social origin, skin color, religion, gender identity and sexual orientation. Just be who you are.

title: Maintenance Technician (m/f/d) part time | ideal alongside your studies
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at ANGEHEUERT GmbH
description_html:
Would you like to maintain more than just another technical system and work with a technology that is truly unique worldwide? ⚡

Our client is a fast growing GreenTech startup developing one of the world’s first scalable road based power plants. The technology uses existing road infrastructure to generate renewable energy from passing traffic without requiring any additional land.

As a Maintenance Technician in Hamburg, you will be responsible for the technical operation and maintenance of the road based power plant installed there. You will ensure reliable operation, carry out maintenance and repairs, and systematically investigate technical faults.

You will not simply follow existing procedures. Since this is an entirely new technology, you will actively help shape how maintenance, service, and technical support processes are developed for the future. Your hands on experience from daily operations will directly contribute to the continued development of the service structure.

Your Benefits

• Unique technology: Work with the world’s first road based power plant in active operation and contribute to a GreenTech solution that currently exists nowhere else in this form.

• Real opportunity to shape processes: Develop maintenance schedules, service processes, and maintenance structures together with the team instead of simply following existing procedures.

• Flexible part time schedule: Work 20 to 30 hours per week with flexible working hours that can easily be combined with university studies or other commitments.

• Independent work: Take responsibility for the technical operation of the plant in Hamburg and enjoy a high degree of autonomy when it comes to maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs.

• Development opportunities: Grow together with the technology and take on additional responsibility for operations and service as your experience increases.

• Attractive compensation: Receive competitive compensation based on your qualifications and practical experience.

Your Responsibilities

As a Maintenance Technician, you will help ensure the reliable technical operation of the road based power plant in Hamburg.

• Maintenance and repairs: Inspect and maintain the system across mechanical, hydraulic, and electrical components. Your responsibilities will also include tasks such as monitoring and maintaining the hydraulic oil.

• Troubleshooting: Analyse technical issues, resolve faults, and document both the solution and the underlying cause.

• Service development: Create and continuously improve maintenance schedules, spare parts lists, and technical service documentation for the system.

• Spare parts management: Keep track of spare parts stored on site and ensure they are managed in a structured and reliable way.

Your Profile as a Maintenance Technician

• You have a technical background in mechanical engineering, mechatronics, energy technology, or a comparable technical qualification.

• You have practical experience in the mechanical maintenance and repair of technical systems or machinery.

• You have a solid understanding of hydraulic systems and are able to independently understand technical relationships and identify potential issues.

• You are available for 20 to 30 hours per week and are flexible enough to occasionally work early mornings, evenings, or weekends when suitable maintenance windows are available at the terminal.

• You enjoy taking responsibility, work independently, and remain calm and solution oriented when dealing with technical problems.

• You enjoy working directly on technical equipment and outdoors and feel comfortable in an active traffic and logistics environment.

• The ability to confidently read technical drawings, hydraulic schematics, and electrical circuit diagrams is an advantage.

Would you like to do more than simply maintain a globally unique GreenTech system and actively help shape how its future operation and service structure are developed? ⚡

Then send us your CV and learn more about the company, the technology, and your future role in a short ten minute introductory call.

title: Systemadministrator Linux (m/w/d) | Hybrid in Freiburg🌄
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at ANGEHEUERT GmbH
description_html:
Du willst Systemadministrator Linux nicht einfach administrieren, sondern selbst entscheiden, wie eine moderne Open Source IT Landschaft aussehen soll?🚀

Dann bekommst du hier den Freiraum dafür. Unser Kunde ist ein wachsendes, familiengeführtes Technologieunternehmen aus Freiburg, das Hard- und Softwarelösungen für die industrielle Bildverarbeitung und Automation entwickelt. Die eigenen Systeme kommen heute in mehr als 15.000 Maschinen weltweit zum Einsatz.

Als Systemadministrator Linux verstärkst du einen bewusst klein gehaltenen IT Bereich und bekommst entsprechend viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Statt starrer Konzernstrukturen erwarten dich kurze Wege, direkter Austausch mit der Geschäftsführung und die Möglichkeit, technische Entscheidungen aktiv mitzugestalten. 

Der technologische Fokus liegt konsequent auf Linux und Open Source. In den kommenden Jahren stehen spannende Themen an: bestehende Anwendungen sollen auf Open Source Alternativen migriert, Cyber Security und Resilience weiter ausgebaut und ein eigener interner Linux basierter KI Server kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt werden. 

Wenn Linux dein fachliches Zuhause ist und du lieber neue Lösungen entwickelst, als nur bestehende Systeme am Laufen zu halten, kannst du hier eine IT Landschaft langfristig mitprägen. 

Deine Benefits

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Entscheide aktiv mit, wie sich die interne IT in den Bereichen Linux, Open Source, Cyber Security, Resilience und Automatisierung weiterentwickelt.  

  • Spannende Zukunftsprojekte: Arbeite unter anderem an Open Source Migrationen, dem Ausbau der IT Security und einem eigenen internen Linux basierten KI Server.  

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit: Arbeite eng mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen und profitiere von kurzen Entscheidungswegen und viel Freiheit bei technischen Lösungen.  

  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Nutze flexible Arbeitszeiten ohne feste Kernarbeitszeit und arbeite in der Regel einen Tag pro Woche im Homeoffice. Individuell kann nach Absprache auch mehr Remote Arbeit möglich sein. 

  • 30 Urlaubstage: Profitiere von 30 Tagen Urlaub und individuellen Lösungen, wenn du darüber hinaus einmal eine längere Auszeit benötigst.  

  • Bonus: Zusätzlich zu deinem Fixgehalt erhältst du einen vom Unternehmenserfolg abhängigen Jahresbonus, der in erfolgreichen Jahren bereits bei mehreren Tausend Euro lag.  

  • Mobilität: Nutze das bezuschusste Deutschlandticket, JobRad, Firmenparkplätze, kostenloses Laden deines E Autos sowie Poolfahrzeuge für dienstliche Termine.  

  • Sport & Gesundheit: Profitiere von Hansefit, einem Boulderfelsen und einer Tischtennisplatte direkt am Standort sowie zahlreichen von Kollegen organisierten Aktivitäten wie Klettern, Mountainbiken oder Kajaken.  

  • Team & Events: Freue dich auf Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier, gemeinsame Grillnachmittage auf der Dachterrasse sowie mehrtägige Entwickler Camps, bei denen bewusst neue Technologien und Themen ausprobiert werden.  

  • Weiterentwicklung: Erhalte individuell abgestimmte Weiterbildungen und einen Mentor aus einem anderen Unternehmensbereich als persönlichen Sparringspartner.  

  • Gehalt: Jahresbruttogehalt ab 60.000 € mit Bereitschaft zur deutlichen Überzahlung abhängig von Qualifikation und Erfahrung. 

Deine Aufgaben

Als Systemadministrator Linux hältst du nicht nur bestehende Systeme am Laufen, sondern entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team die zukünftige IT-Landschaft des Unternehmens. 

  • Linux & Infrastruktur: Verantworte und optimiere die Linux Systemlandschaft sowie die zugehörige Netzwerk- und IT-Infrastruktur.  

  • Open Source: Entwickle bestehende Systeme konsequent weiter und begleite Migrationen von Standardsoftware zu geeigneten Open Source Alternativen.  

  • Virtualisierung & Automatisierung: Arbeite mit Technologien wie Proxmox, Docker und vSphere und automatisiere Prozesse beispielsweise mit Python und Ansible.  

  • Cyber Security: Entwickle Security und Resilience weiter und beschäftige dich mit technischen Anforderungen rund um NIS 2, DSGVO, CRA und TISAX.  

  • KI Infrastruktur: Betreue und erweitere den unternehmenseigenen Linux basierten KI-Server und schaffe eine sichere Infrastruktur für die interne Nutzung künstlicher Intelligenz.  

  • Technischer Support: Löse komplexere interne IT-Fragestellungen für überwiegend technisch versierte Anwender mit Schwerpunkt auf dem zweiten und dritten Supportlevel. 

Dein Profil Systemadministrator Linux

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker, IT-Systemadministrator, abgeschlossenes Informatikstudium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.  

  • Mindestens zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung mit klarem Schwerpunkt auf Linux Administration nach Abschluss deiner Ausbildung oder deines Studiums.  

  • Sehr gute Linux Kenntnisse: Du arbeitest bereits routiniert mit Linux und möchtest dich nicht erst in das Betriebssystem einarbeiten.  

  • Solides Verständnis von Netzwerktechnik, Netzwerkprotokollen und IT-Infrastruktur.  

  • Erfahrung mit Virtualisierung oder Containertechnologien wie Proxmox, Docker oder vSphere.  

  • Kenntnisse in der Automatisierung, beispielsweise mit Python, Ansible oder vergleichbaren Technologien.  

  • Begeisterung für Open Source und Interesse daran, eine IT-Landschaft langfristig auf offenen und sicheren Lösungen aufzubauen.  

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1 Niveau sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse.

Der technologische Fokus liegt konsequent auf Linux und Open Source. In den kommenden Jahren stehen spannende Themen an: bestehende Anwendungen sollen auf Open Source Alternativen migriert, Cyber Security und Resilience weiter ausgebaut und ein eigener interner Linux basierter KI Server kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt werden. 

Wenn Linux dein fachliches Zuhause ist und du lieber neue Lösungen entwickelst, als nur bestehende Systeme am Laufen zu halten, kannst du hier eine IT Landschaft langfristig mitprägen. 

Deine Benefits

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Entscheide aktiv mit, wie sich die interne IT in den Bereichen Linux, Open Source, Cyber Security, Resilience und Automatisierung weiterentwickelt.  

  • Spannende Zukunftsprojekte: Arbeite unter anderem an Open Source Migrationen, dem Ausbau der IT Security und einem eigenen internen Linux basierten KI Server.  

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit: Arbeite eng mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen und profitiere von kurzen Entscheidungswegen und viel Freiheit bei technischen Lösungen.  

  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Nutze flexible Arbeitszeiten ohne feste Kernarbeitszeit und arbeite in der Regel einen Tag pro Woche im Homeoffice. Individuell kann nach Absprache auch mehr Remote Arbeit möglich sein. 

  • 30 Urlaubstage: Profitiere von 30 Tagen Urlaub und individuellen Lösungen, wenn du darüber hinaus einmal eine längere Auszeit benötigst.

  • Mobilität: Nutze das bezuschusste Deutschlandticket, JobRad, Firmenparkplätze, kostenloses Laden deines E Autos sowie Poolfahrzeuge für dienstliche Termine.  

  • Sport & Gesundheit: Profitiere von Hansefit, einem Boulderfelsen und einer Tischtennisplatte direkt am Standort sowie zahlreichen von Kollegen organisierten Aktivitäten wie Klettern, Mountainbiken oder Kajaken.  

  • Team & Events: Freue dich auf Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier, gemeinsame Grillnachmittage auf der Dachterrasse sowie mehrtägige Entwickler Camps, bei denen bewusst neue Technologien und Themen ausprobiert werden.  

  • Weiterentwicklung: Erhalte individuell abgestimmte Weiterbildungen und einen Mentor aus einem anderen Unternehmensbereich als persönlichen Sparringspartner.  

  • Gehalt: Jahresbruttogehalt ab 60.000 € mit Bereitschaft zur deutlichen Überzahlung abhängig von Qualifikation und Erfahrung. 

Deine Aufgaben

Als Systemadministrator Linux hältst du nicht nur bestehende Systeme am Laufen, sondern entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team die zukünftige IT-Landschaft des Unternehmens. 

  • Linux & Infrastruktur: Verantworte und optimiere die Linux Systemlandschaft sowie die zugehörige Netzwerk- und IT-Infrastruktur.  

  • Open Source: Entwickle bestehende Systeme konsequent weiter und begleite Migrationen von Standardsoftware zu geeigneten Open Source Alternativen.  

  • Virtualisierung & Automatisierung: Arbeite mit Technologien wie Proxmox, Docker und vSphere und automatisiere Prozesse beispielsweise mit Python und Ansible.  

  • Cyber Security: Entwickle Security und Resilience weiter und beschäftige dich mit technischen Anforderungen rund um NIS 2, DSGVO, CRA und TISAX.  

  • KI Infrastruktur: Betreue und erweitere den unternehmenseigenen Linux basierten KI-Server und schaffe eine sichere Infrastruktur für die interne Nutzung künstlicher Intelligenz.  

  • Technischer Support: Löse komplexere interne IT-Fragestellungen für überwiegend technisch versierte Anwender mit Schwerpunkt auf dem zweiten und dritten Supportlevel. 

Dein Profil Systemadministrator Linux

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker, IT-Systemadministrator, abgeschlossenes Informatikstudium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.  

  • Mindestens zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung mit klarem Schwerpunkt auf Linux Administration nach Abschluss deiner Ausbildung oder deines Studiums.  

  • Sehr gute Linux Kenntnisse: Du arbeitest bereits routiniert mit Linux und möchtest dich nicht erst in das Betriebssystem einarbeiten.  

  • Solides Verständnis von Netzwerktechnik, Netzwerkprotokollen und IT-Infrastruktur.  

  • Erfahrung mit Virtualisierung oder Containertechnologien wie Proxmox, Docker oder vSphere.  

  • Kenntnisse in der Automatisierung, beispielsweise mit Python, Ansible oder vergleichbaren Technologien.  

  • Begeisterung für Open Source und Interesse daran, eine IT-Landschaft langfristig auf offenen und sicheren Lösungen aufzubauen.  

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1 Niveau sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse.

title: Recruiter / Talent Acquisition Manager (all genders)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Foodji GmbH
description_html:
Wir öffnen eine neue, zentrale Position in unserem Team: eine Person, die Recruiting nicht als Aufgabe, sondern als Handwerk und Hebel für Unternehmenserfolg versteht. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für die Besetzung von Rollen über alle Funktionen und Senioritätsstufen hinweg – von Fachexpert:innen bis Führungspositionen – und gestaltest gleichzeitig aktiv mit, wie Talent Acquisition bei uns strukturell und strategisch weiterwächst.

Wir suchen jemanden, der im Recruiting bereits angekommen ist - mit fundierter Praxis, einem klaren Verständnis für die Mechanik guter Prozesse und dem Ehrgeiz, den Bereich aktiv mitzuprägen. Du bewegst dich souverän zwischen operativer Exzellenz und strategischem Weitblick, zwischen Tempo und Präzision, zwischen Beratung und klarer Kante gegenüber Stakeholdern bis auf C-Level.

Recruiting bei uns ist kein ruhiges Gewässer. Es ist schnell, anspruchsvoll und ergebnisorientiert. Genau das soll dich reizen, nicht abschrecken.

Was du bewegst

Operative Verantwortung

  • End-to-End-Ownership vielfältiger Recruiting-Prozesse – unterschiedliche Funktionen, unterschiedliche Level, unterschiedliche Herausforderungen

  • Sparringspartner:in für Hiring Manager, Leadership und C-Level – von der Anforderungsschärfung bis zur finalen Entscheidung

  • Strukturierte, kompetenzbasierte Interviewführung mit hohem Anspruch an Qualität und Fairness

  • Aktive Marktbearbeitung durch gezieltes Sourcing

  • Eine Candidate Experience, die auch unter Zeitdruck überzeugt

Strategisches Ownership

  • Mitgestaltung des Talent-Acquisition-Bereichs in enger Abstimmung mit dem Head of - strukturell, prozessual, strategisch

  • Volle Verantwortung für den Recruiting-Funnel: Kennzahlen definieren, Conversion steigern, Engpässe erkennen, konsequent nachschärfen

  • Aufbau strategischer Talent Pools für Profile, die immer wieder gefragt sind

  • Entwicklung von Active-Search-Strategien

  • Verantwortung für Recruiting-Tools und -Systeme - von Auswahl bis Optimierung

  • Aufbau externer Partnerschaften, die unser Recruiting schlagkräftiger machen


DAS BRINGST DU MIT

  • Praktische Recruiting-Erfahrung, im Idealfall bereits über mehrere Funktionen und Senioritäten hinweg

  • Ein geschärftes Verständnis für strukturierte, datenbasierte Recruiting-Prozesse und Active Sourcing

  • Souveränität und Verhandlungsgeschick im Umgang mit anspruchsvollen Stakeholdern bis in die Geschäftsführung

  • Die Fähigkeit, gleichzeitig operativ tief einzusteigen und strategisch den Überblick zu behalten

  • Belastbarkeit und einen kühlen Kopf, wenn mehrere kritische Suchen parallel unter Druck stehen

  • Ein analytischer Blick auf Funnel, Kennzahlen und Prozessqualität

  • Verbindlichkeit, Beratungsstärke und den Mut, auch unbequeme Empfehlungen auszusprechen

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

 

NOCH FRAGEN?

Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht und helfen dir gerne weiter!

DAS BIETEN WIR

  • Office Foodji & Lunchit App: Immer bestens versorgt bei uns im Office oder Remote

  • bAV: Mit der Degura Pension Cloud sichern und bezuschussen wir jetzt schon deine Rente

  • Spendit Card: Wir stocken dein Gehalt auf! Mit Spendit stehen dir bis zu fünfzig Euro netto im Monat on top zur freien Verfügung

  • EGYM Wellpass: Mit uns bleibst du fit & wir bringen dich deutschlandweit in die angesagtesten Fitness- und Wellnessstudios

  • JobRad: Spring mit uns aufs Rad und lease dir dein Traumrad oder Pedelec

  • KITA/Kiga Kostenzuschuss: Wir bezuschussen deine Kosten für die Kinderbetreuung, damit deine Kinder immer bestens versorgt sind

  • Mitarbeiterrabatte: Du erhältst attraktive Promotions und Discounts verschiedener Brands

  • Food Tastings: Teste dich mit unserem Foodteam durch unsere Produkte und gestalte unser Sortiment von morgen

  • Development: Deine Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen und mit regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen und Trainings bieten wir dir spannende Entwicklungspfade – z. B. vom SDR zum Account Executive

  • Flexwork: Arbeite 30 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU Ausland

  • Top Office Lage: Genieße eine erstklassige Arbeitsumgebung im Münchener Glockenbachviertel mit der Isar vor der Tür

  • Team Events: Wir sind ein Team - beim Skiday, Frühstück, Culture Week oder Office Party feiern wir gemeinsam!

ÜBER UNS

Hi, schön, dass du da bist! Wir sind Foodji - ein Team aus Food-Lovern & Tech-Nerds.

Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltags verbringen – in Büros, ganz gleich, ob im Gewerbegebiet oder mitten in der Stadt, während langer Schichten im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. Überall bieten wir vollwertige Gerichte, Snacks und Getränke genau dort an, wo und wann du sie brauchst.

Proprietäre Technologien, selbstlernende Algorithmen und effiziente Lieferketten helfen uns dabei, das Paradox zwischen frischem Essen, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit aufzulösen. Mit unserer eigens entwickelten Technologieplattform optimieren wir die Mengenplanung und sagen Food Waste den Kampf an. Wir wollen einen positiven Effekt erzielen – auf die Umwelt, den Alltag unserer Kund:innen und unsere Communities. Deshalb spenden wir übrig gebliebene Gerichte an Foodsharing und andere soziale Initiativen direkt vor unserer Haustür.

Als Marktführer versorgen wir mit Foodji bereits täglich Tausende Menschen in ganz Deutschland. Zu unseren Kund:innen zählen unter anderem der Münchner Flughafen, Klarna, Enpal und Wingcopter. Und wir fangen gerade erst an: Allein in Deutschland gibt es mehr als 100.000 relevante Standorte für uns.

Trage auch du deinen Teil dazu bei und bewirb dich jetzt.

description_html:
About us

Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

The opportunity
We are searching for a Staff Software Engineer to join our Search team. The role entails contributing to the product & technical domains of excellence in the main API product that enables large retailers to seamlessly purchase tickets from bus & rail carriers worldwide. The team enables a booking system that includes booking orchestration, invoicing, ticketing, and more.

What you will do:

  • Drive the strategic architectural transition of our core Search Engine from Elixir to Go as the pioneer Go engineer.

  • Design foundational infrastructure for high-throughput microservices to ensure smooth interoperability between the new Go architecture and legacy systems.

  • Own the technical backlog and success metrics while coordinating cross-functional work to strictly align with long-term business objectives.

  • Resolve technical bottlenecks and guide teams to build solutions that maximize business value and justify migration decisions.

  • Lead company-wide technology adoption and agile engineering processes while maintaining highly effective documentation.

  • Systematically elevate the team's technical capabilities by upskilling your peers in Go best practices.

Workplace: Berlin

We are a remote-first company with teams located around the Globe and a HQ in Berlin.


Who you are:

  • You bring 7+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years in Golang.

  • You ideally have some knowledge of Ruby or Python to effectively navigate our legacy ecosystem and drive the transition.

  • You have deep architectural mastery of high-throughput distributed systems, microservices, Elasticsearch, Kubernetes, and GCP.

  • You can seamlessly translate complex technical decisions into business metrics to identify and resolve growth hurdles.

  • You excel at cross-functional leadership, synchronizing technologies and ensuring total transparency between developers, partners, and stakeholders.

  • You champion an agile mindset, test-driven development, and robust CI/CD pipelines to maximize efficiency during technical transitions.

  • You are deeply passionate about continuous self-development and actively mentoring others.

  • You are fluent in English, both verbally and in writing.

What you can expect:

  • Make a global impact. Help shape how millions of people discover and book ground transportation worldwide.

  • Own your work. Take responsibility from day one and see the direct impact of your contributions.

  • Build with the best tools. We move fast, continuously evolve our tech stack, and invest in modern, efficient solutions.

  • Work with industry leaders. Our partners include Booking.com, Google Maps, Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF.

  • Grow with exceptional people. Join an international team that will challenge, support, and inspire you every day.

  • Work your way. Enjoy flexible and remote-friendly working options, relocation opportunities, and plenty of room to grow.

title: AI Science Writer, Nebius Academy (Contract)

description_html:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Science Writer, Nebius Academy (Contract) based in Germany.

As an AI Science Writer, you’ll translate cutting-edge AI and machine learning research into accurate, engaging, and accessible stories.
You’ll work at the intersection of scientific research, technical communication, journalism, and multimedia storytelling.
A core part of the role will be reviewing new models, architectures, papers, and research to identify what is genuinely novel and important.
You’ll turn complex technical concepts into compelling written and visual narratives through articles, explainers, diagrams, charts, and other formats.
You’ll engage directly with researchers, engineers, founders, and scientific leaders to investigate ideas and verify technical claims.
The role also offers opportunities to cover major conferences, host research-focused events, and experiment with AI-assisted editorial workflows.
This is an ongoing contract position with a fixed monthly retainer, flexibility, and potential opportunities for longer-term career growth.


Accountabilities
  • Produce accurate and engaging scientific and technical reviews covering new AI models, architectures, research papers, internal research, and emerging trends.
  • Analyze technical papers and research findings to identify meaningful innovations, understand methodologies, evaluate limitations, and communicate their significance.
  • Transform complex model architectures and technical concepts into clear visual narratives, including infographics, diagrams, charts, and other multimedia elements.
  • Develop written content across multiple formats, including analytical reports, long-form features, interviews, technical explainers, newsletters, webinar scripts, and social media content.
  • Interview researchers, engineers, founders, and scientific leaders to uncover insights and provide context for stories.
  • Cover major AI research conferences, emerging fields, significant developments, and important discussions across the AI ecosystem.
  • Host or moderate research webinars, interviews, and other on-camera or multimedia formats.
  • Work directly with researchers to fact-check and verify technical claims while maintaining a clear, engaging editorial voice.
  • Collaborate with designers and multimedia producers on more complex visual and interactive stories.
  • Create visual assets independently where appropriate, using AI tools and other relevant technologies to support the production process.
  • Experiment with AI models, agents, coding, and automation to improve research, editorial, analysis, and visual-production workflows.
  • Contribute to an editorial environment focused on making advanced scientific research accessible without oversimplifying its underlying complexity.

    • Requirements:

    • Professional or academic experience in AI/ML research, machine learning engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.
    • A degree in computer science, machine learning, mathematics, physics, engineering, computational science, or another relevant technical field.
    • Strong ability to read and interpret scientific papers, inspect model architectures, compare experimental results, and discuss technical details directly with researchers.
    • Strong technical writing and editorial skills, with the ability to communicate complex scientific concepts accurately, clearly, and engagingly.
    • Strong visual communication instincts and the ability to explain technical mechanisms through diagrams, infographics, charts, and other multimedia formats.
    • Ability to assess the significance and limitations of research rather than simply summarize findings.
    • Excellent interviewing and communication skills, with confidence engaging researchers, engineers, and technical experts.
    • Comfortable working across multiple content formats and adapting technical material for different audiences and channels.
    • Familiarity with LLMs and AI-assisted content or research workflows, using these tools to enhance productivity while maintaining personal editorial judgement and authorship.
    • Curiosity about emerging developments in AI, machine learning, and scientific research.
    • Strong attention to accuracy, fact-checking, and technical detail.
    • Ability to work independently, take ownership of projects, and collaborate effectively with researchers, designers, and multimedia professionals.
    • Candidates must be authorized to work in the country where they are based.

      • Benefits:

      • Competitive compensation through a fixed monthly contract retainer.
      • Ongoing contract engagement with opportunities for professional growth and potential transition to a full-time position.
      • Flexible working arrangements within Europe.
      • High degree of ownership over research, editorial projects, and storytelling formats.
      • Opportunities to work on impactful projects at the forefront of AI and machine learning.
      • Career growth and continuous learning opportunities.
      • Collaboration with researchers, engineers, scientific leaders, designers, and multimedia professionals.
      • International working environment with talented teams across multiple locations.
      • Opportunity to experiment with AI tools, agents, coding, and automation in modern editorial workflows.
      • Fast-moving environment where innovative ideas and individual contributions can have a visible impact.

title: Working Student Export Control & Trade Compliance (all genders)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Stark
description_html:
About Us

STARK is a new kind of defence technology company. We design, develop, and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are software-defined, mass-scalable, and cost-effective, changing how autonomous systems are deployed across multiple domains. This gives our operators a decisive edge in highly contested environments. As threats rise, STARK is strengthening the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners to deter aggression and defend Europe.


About the team

Du wirst Teil unseres Teams an der Schnittstelle zwischen internationalem Handel, Exportkontrolle und dem operativen Tagesgeschäft bei STARK. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus verschiedenen Bereichen wie Vertrieb, Einkauf und Logistik zusammen. Von Anfang an arbeitest du an realen Fällen und sammelst praktische Erfahrung in einem schnelllebigen internationalen Umfeld.


Your mission

Als Werkstudent im Bereich Exportkontrolle unterstützt du uns dabei, nationale und internationale Exportkontrollvorgaben zuverlässig in unsere täglichen Geschäftsprozesse zu integrieren.

Du arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Fachabteilungen wie Vertrieb, Einkauf und Logistik zusammen und unterstützt bei konkreten Fragestellungen rund um Exportgenehmigungen, Sanktionen, Güterklassifizierungen und länderbezogene Restriktionen.

Dabei erhältst du direkten Einblick in reale Fälle des internationalen Handels- und Exportkontrollrechts und kannst dein theoretisches Wissen unmittelbar in der Praxis anwenden.


Responsibilities

  • Du beantwortest tägliche Fragen aus Fachabteilungen, zum Beispiel Vertrieb, Einkauf und Logistik, zu exportkontrollrelevanten Abläufen und Prüfschritten.
  • Du unterstützt aktiv bei der Vorbereitung und Ausarbeitung von Ausfuhrgenehmigungsanträgen beim Bundesamt für Wirtschaft und Ausfuhrkontrolle (BAFA).
  • Vor geplanten Exporten führst du Recherchen zu Exportgenehmigungen, Sanktionen, Güterklassifizierungen und länderbezogenen Restriktionen durch.
  • Du analysierst und dokumentierst vergangene Ausfuhr- und Zolldaten zur Risikoanalyse und zur Vorbereitung interner und externer Audits.
  • Du erstellst, prüfst und verwaltest eigenverantwortlich Endverbleibserklärungen für Kunden, Lieferanten und Behörden.


Qualifications

  • Du bist immatrikulierter Student (all genders) im Bereich Wirtschaftsrecht, Rechtswissenschaften, BWL, Logistik, International Business oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung.
  • Du verfügst über ein grundlegendes Verständnis oder starkes Interesse am deutschen und europäischen Exportkontrollrecht, insbesondere AWG/AWV und der EU-Dual-Use-Verordnung.
  • Du hast Freude daran, komplexe Regelungen verständlich zu vermitteln und deine Kolleginnen und Kollegen lösungsorientiert zu unterstützen.
  • Du arbeitest sehr sorgfältig, strukturiert und eigenverantwortlich.
  • Du verfügst über verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse.


Nice to have

Erste praktische Erfahrungen im Bereich Exportkontrolle, Zoll, Compliance oder Außenwirtschaft, zum Beispiel durch Praktika oder Werkstudententätigkeiten
